name: postquant
description: A post-quantum L1 whose entire state machine is a market in key/value space, with pluggable post-quantum key types where the algorithm IS a wasm module. Signatures come from two families that share nothing — ML-DSA 44/65/87 (FIPS 204, module lattices) and SLH-DSA-SHAKE-128f (FIPS 205, nothing but SHAKE256) — chosen per wallet, with the address committing to the choice; every commitment is SHA3-256 and there is no elliptic curve anywhere in the trust path. Every transaction witness is verified INSIDE the compiled wasm verifier registered for its key type (blob SHA3-256 committed in pq/wasm/manifest.json, checked on both sides of the process boundary, fail closed), so what a valid signature means is pinned to exact bytes any node can hash, ship and re-run — and a future key type is one plugin file plus one blob, not a fork. There is one thing to own on this chain, a key in the store, and the whole protocol is the market for it: write gas per byte (a key byte costs 4x a value byte, hash values below blobs), witness gas per byte of signature billed per scheme as-is (2420 for ML-DSA-44, 17088 for SLH-DSA — the honest price of resting on nothing but hashes), and rent per byte-hour against a prepaid escrow. Expiry makes entries sweepable for their bond; the fee market is EIP-1559 over state growth. Consensus is a single proposer — authority, not agreement — but verify replays every block from genesis and re-runs every witness through its key type's wasm. REST, the browser console and 24 MCP tools on one port, off the same functions.
backend: python stdlib only (http.server + hashlib) — no dependencies; ML-DSA, SLH-DSA and ML-KEM implemented in pq/, witness verification in per-algorithm wasm (dependency-free Rust, bare rustc, run by a node host)
frontend: console.html — the tip, the store, the market, write/quote, wallets with per-scheme creation, the key-type table, the whitepaper; served at /postquant
state: ~/.mod/postquant — keys.json (32-byte seeds, mode 0600, never committed), <chain_id>/blocks.jsonl (the log, the truth), <chain_id>/state.json (a snapshot, discarded if it disagrees with the log)

crypto.signatures: pluggable per account: ML-DSA-44/65/87 (FIPS 204, pq/mldsa.py) and SLH-DSA-SHAKE-128f (FIPS 205, pq/slhdsa.py); registry pq/algos.py, plugins in pq/algos.d/
crypto.verification: every witness runs inside the wasm verifier registered for its key type — pq/wasmvm.py + pq/wasm/manifest.json (SHA3-256 per blob, fail closed); Rust sources + parity tests in pq/wasm-src/
crypto.hash: SHA3-256 everywhere: addresses, tx ids, Merkle roots, commitments
crypto.addresses: pq + first 20 bytes of SHA3-256 over (algorithm domain, public key) — the address commits to the key type
crypto.quantum_gate: algorithms declaring quantum_safe=false register and appear in pq_algos but cannot witness a transaction (POSTQUANT_ALLOW_CLASSICAL=1 opens the gate on a throwaway devnet)

economics.write_gas: per byte of key (400), value (100 raw / 40 hash), witness (3), settled at a floating base fee that is burned
economics.rent: 1000 nq per byte-hour against a prepaid escrow; expiry makes the entry sweepable for its bond
economics.fee_market: EIP-1559 over state growth: target 4096 bytes/block, +-12.5% per block

auth.gate: optional — writes only, and only when ~/.mod/postquant/server.secret exists
auth.why: those routes spend PQ or touch the keystore; every route that only reads the chain is open, because a chain nobody can read is not one

endpoints.writes: POST /set /del /fund /sweep /list /buy /transfer /wallet /faucet /mine — JSON bodies, same args as the tools

env.POSTQUANT_PORT: port for API, console and MCP (default 51030)
env.POSTQUANT_SCHEME: default key type for new wallets (default ML-DSA-44; pq_algos lists the choices)
env.POSTQUANT_HEARTBEAT: seconds between empty blocks so rent keeps settling (default 60)
env.POSTQUANT_WASM: on (default) requires every witness to verify in its key type's wasm; off is the explicit dev-only opt-out
env.POSTQUANT_WASM_NODE: path to the node runtime for the wasm host (default: node on PATH)
env.POSTQUANT_WASM_TIMEOUT: seconds to wait for one wasm verification (default 30)
env.POSTQUANT_ALLOW_CLASSICAL: accept witnesses from algorithms that declared quantum_safe=false (devnet only)
